body_text:
Most people spend 6 months searching for a property and still aren't sure if they made the right call. We make sure our clients don’t

Hey, it’s Shanice here.

I’ve seen it happen too often. 

Buyers go from viewing to viewing, relying on gut feel, opinions, or what “sounds good”…

Only to second-guess themselves after committing.

The biggest misconception?

That property decisions should be based on instinct or hype.

But in today’s market, that’s risky.

Here’s what actually works 👇

✅ Data beats opinions, every single time

✅ Past transaction trends reveal real buyer behaviour

✅ The right shortlist saves you months of uncertainty

Here are some insights you may not know:

INSIGHT #1: The market already tells you what works.

We’ve compiled a database of hundreds of condos that TOPed in the last 10 years, tracking every unit, every transaction. 

This isn’t theory. It’s real buyers putting real money into proven projects.

INSIGHT #2: Not all condos perform equally.

By analysing annualised gains, rental data, and median PSF.

We can clearly see which developments consistently outperform.

And which ones don’t. The difference isn’t small.

INSIGHT #3: Clarity changes everything

Instead of walking into viewings unsure, you’ll have a refined shortlist already stress-tested against 10 years of market behaviour. 

That’s confidence most buyers never get.

📊 Condo Performance Data Set (Last 10 Years)

✅ How to avoid the costliest mistakes

✅ Which 3 projects have strong profit potential this year

✅ A framework to make your next move with confidence

If you want to stop guessing and start making data-backed decisions

click “Learn More” and I’ll walk you through it.

transcript_text: Most people spend about 6 months searching for their property and they aren't even sure if they've made the right choice. We make sure our clients don't regret anything. So we've built a database of hundreds of condos that have TOP'd in the last 10 years. Every unit, every transaction, we've calculated annualized gains, rental use, median PSF, and this has all been ranked just for you. And here's what the data tells you. The condos at the top of this list are not the opinions of just one agent or one buyer. These are all verified transaction data. thousands of real buyers paying real money at real prices for the last decade. And this is not gut feeling. This is actually a proven track record that the market itself has validated. So when you work with our database, you are not just hoping or praying that you made the right call. You're entering every viewing with a shortlist that has already been stress tested against 10 years of market behavior. That's the collective wisdom of the market. And it doesn't lie because data doesn't lie. With this data set, you are able to buy with clarity that most buyers do not have because they were never shown this data in the first place. Don't let your feelings and emotions guide you through the biggest purchase of your life. If you'd like to find out more about this data set that we have done, drop me a message and I'll be happy to walk you through it. Bye!
